Kiseki (Winter Jersey) enters walking

From the spectator stands, I watch over Kiseki alongside the other trainers whose eyes are glued to her running.
Watching her press forward on her daring, solitary crusade against top-tier contenders.

No, no way! Can Kiseki even hold out?!
A frontrunning strategy like that wasn't once part of our training...!

Surging ever forward from the front in a fierce, bold escape.
This was the thrilling narrative... she had envisioned.
...Were you able to teach her enough fundamentals to overcome that?

Yes. Only through winning can one truly become the protagonist!
Just you wait and see what happens next... Get excited!
—Kh!

It's so much more thrilling than creating alone...!
And so much more frustrating than when I was by myself...!

Yet they believed that if it was Kiseki, she would 'create something truly fascinating.'
And on that pouring rainy day, Kiseki came up with a brilliant idea—

"Wait... What does that mean—"
"The race has started! Look, Kiseki is—!"
I'm gonna wiiiiiiiiiin—!
*pant*... *pant*... —Not yet! Not yeet!!
What you and I are creating is—

Her run struck the chasing pack as a completely unexpected move.
Everyone's eyes were fixed on her back. Everyone was—

Well, it's Kiseki's call. ...Hey, Trainer?
You must have a plan to make her win that none of us could think of, right?

That is why this run was meant for this one, single practice race.
The run to win that she believed would be the most exciting of all.

Previously on Kiseki's story! While receiving guidance from various trainers,
Kiseki is asked by a friendly trainer to reconsider her strategy.
—Kh!

(Trainer, I'm sure you're...
getting thrilled by my running again, aren't you?)

...Kh, I was happy just having you watch me, but...!
Creating this together with you was so much fun! So—!!

She can pull it off with a completely different style from last time...?
Could something like that... Could such an unthinkable "miracle" really come true...?!

Kiseki's front-running lead was overtaken on the final stretch.
...Victory slipped through her fingers.

...Th-This is ridiculous! The standard rule of racing is for an Umamusume
to lock down her own winning formula! And yet...—!
I came in... second place............!
I wanted to win together with you...!

...But, but still! I was way more hyped than during the last practice race,
and running felt absolute peak perfection!

(Because my own heart is pounding so hard right now!
It won't stop, I can't stop! Just like this—)

Even against opponents hiding such overwhelming strength,
I will—

Satono Crown-chan and Satono Diamond-chan, just like last time.
Plus... Vivlos-chan's big sister, Cheval Grand-chan.

And sparked by those words of yours, I decided to prepare a brand-new—
the ultimate plan. That's all accurate so far, right?
——...This is our "story."
...And so, I took your hand.

*inhale*... *exhale*... ...Let's review.
On that rainy day, you praised my grit and stamina.

Strategy meeting over, then? ...Watching the last race, what I felt
Kiseki lacked was pacing her reserves and late-stretch burst.

Peak excitement, burning with passion.
A manga-like story—of Kiseki.

Whyyy did Kiseki turn me down!?
I could have honed her strong points too! And yet—!

——...Now, several weeks later.
Kiseki was thrilled by the plan she had crafted with him.

——...Now, several weeks later.
Kiseki was thrilled by the plan she had crafted with her.
...Today, I'm about to face some seriously crazy-strong opponents.

Th-That certainly gets the heart racing! Wait, hold on!
Does that mean your plan is to convert Kiseki into a Front-Runner!?

*pant*... *pant*...!
...——Trainer...!

What Kiseki seeks is a run that makes the race as exciting as possible.
And to claim victory in that thrilling race—to become the protagonist.
Whaaat!? She's running from the Front!?
And then, Kiseki—
And so, the day of the rematch practice race arrived.

...Kh, Trainer! Can we have one last strategy check!
Um, just! Two panels is all I need!
...~~Kh, Traineeeeeeeer!!
